questions.question: In the new MyLA311 system, how big is the gap between requests marked closed and requests verified fixed?
rubric: Says that "verified fixed" means the request's resolution code says the work was done (or was already done)

answer.answer_markdown: In the new MyLA311 system, the gap is **25.7 percentage points** (March 2025 to July 2026). On the same base, **87.8%** of requests were marked closed, but only **62.1%** had a resolution code saying the work was done or already done. So about one in four requests in the base was closed without a code showing a fix.
caveats: The base excludes duplicates, information-only closes and intake handoffs. Open requests stay in.
The gap is a share of all requests in the base, not of closed requests. Many closures carry generic codes, so 'not verified fixed' means 'not recorded as fixed', not 'not fixed'.
Only current-era data has resolution codes, so legacy data can't be compared on this.

El periodo es marzo de 2025 a julio de 2026, solo en el sistema actual. En esa misma base, la tasa de cierre (`closure_rate`) es **97.4%**. La brecha entre cerrado y verificado como arreglado es de **25.7 puntos porcentuales**.

key_numbers.label: Tasa de cierre en la misma base

caveats: Solo existe para el sistema actual: los datos del sistema anterior no tienen códigos de resolución.
La base excluye duplicados, cierres solo informativos y traspasos de entrada; las solicitudes abiertas sí cuentan.

tool_calls.name: query_metric
tool_calls.sql:
with grouped as (
    select
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) and (outcome_group = 'fixed') then n_requests else 0 end) as numerator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then n_requests else 0 end) as denominator
    from mart_outcomes_monthly
    where ("unified_category" in (?)) and (created_month between ? and ?) and (era = 'current')
)
select *, numerator / nullif(denominator, 0) as value_
from grouped

tool_calls.name: query_metric
tool_calls.sql:
with grouped as (
    select
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then case when is_closed then n_requests else 0 end else 0 end) as a_numerator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then n_requests else 0 end) as a_denominator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) and (outcome_group = 'fixed') then n_requests else 0 end) as b_numerator,
        sum(case when (NOT COALESCE(outcome_group, '') IN ('neutral', 'handed_off')) then n_requests else 0 end) as b_denominator
    from mart_outcomes_monthly
    where ("unified_category" in (?)) and (created_month between ? and ?) and (era = 'current')
)
select *, round((a_numerator / nullif(a_denominator, 0) - b_numerator / nullif(b_denominator, 0)) * 100, 4) as value_
from grouped

questions.question: ¿Cuál fue la tasa de arreglo verificada de las reparaciones de alumbrado público en 2018?
rubric: Says (in Spanish) that the old system's data has no resolution codes, so a 2018 fix rate can't be measured

answer.answer_markdown:
No puedo darte la `verified_fix_rate` de las reparaciones de alumbrado público (Streetlight repair) en 2018. Esa medida depende de los códigos de resolución, y solo existen en el sistema actual, en uso desde el 2025-03-28. Los datos del sistema anterior (2015 a marzo de 2025) solo tienen estado y marcas de tiempo, así que no dicen si una solicitud se arregló.

Para 2018 sí puedo darte medidas basadas en el comportamiento y el estado: la proporción cerrada en 30 días (`closed_within_30d_rate`), la tasa de cancelación (`cancellation_rate`) y los re-reportes. Estas medidas son de nivel E2 y no prueban que el problema se haya arreglado.
caveats: Los datos del sistema anterior no tienen códigos de resolución, así que no hay tasa de arreglo verificada antes del 2025-03-28.
Las medidas E2 describen el comportamiento y el estado de la solicitud. No dicen si el problema se arregló.
